configuration.prior_information: The complete timeline batch improved both folds but missed the seasonal margin (best 323.4327816874519 / 221.88908249663194). The arrival-context experts worsened seasonal scores and are excluded. This final bounded follow-up applies the already frozen combined timeline features to the unchanged airport learner settings.
configuration.refit_iterations: Each new airport component uses its own ties-to-even rounded median of the two October-selected counts. Active new timeline global components use their previously declared October medians; original v6 imports are unchanged.
configuration.selection: Finish twenty airport fits and all four fixed complete recipes. Require at least 0.5% lower complete RMSE than v6 on both original folds, then choose the lowest equal-weight mean relative RMSE. Every clock-missing prediction stays at v6. No per-airport selection or weighting.
